title: SBCapSeq Protocol: a method for selective cloning of _Sleeping Beauty_ transposon insertions using liquid capture hybridization and Ion Torrent semiconductor sequencing
protocol: Choose one source of genomic DNA below for SBCapSeq workflow.
Isolate genomic DNA from flash frozen specimens according to the Gentra Puregene Handbook protocol for DNA purification from tissue frozen in liquid nitrogen.
Shave off fine sections of frozen tissue equaling 10 mg, working on ice at all times, and add directly to Cell Lysis Solution.
Incubate overnight at 55 °C with Proteinase K for maximum yields.
Resuspend DNA pellet in 100 μL of DNA Hydration Solution once DNA is completely dissolved.
Quantify the DNA after complete dissolution.
Quantify genomic DNA extraction using either NanoDrop™ Lite Spectrophotometer or Qubit® 3.0 Fluorometer with Qubit dsDNA BR Assay Kit per manufacturer’s recommended instructions.
Repeat genomic DNA extraction as needed to obtain ≥500 ng of genomic DNA for library preparation.
Fragment genomic DNA by enzymatic shearing according to the Ion Xpress™ Plus and Ion Plus Library Preparation User Guide for barcoded libraries.
Dilute 5 μL of Ion Xpress™ P1 Adapter in 40 μL E1 Buffer.
Dilute 5 μL of Ion Xpress™ Barcode Adapter in 40 μL E1 Buffer.
Choose Auto SizeSelection and Auto Shearing to target a shear-size of 200 bp when starting the run.
Remove small amounts of Agencourt AMPure XP Reagent by placing samples in a DynaMag™-2 magnet for two minutes, then transferring the supernatant to a new tube.
Fragment genomic DNA by acoustic shearing following protocols in 130 μL volume using the Covaris S220 System.
Use a buffer of at least 0.1X TE for shearing.
Use screw cap microtubes with double rods.
Pipette genomic DNA into the microTUBE AFA Fiber Pre-Slit Snap-Cap carefully, ensuring no air bubbles remain.
Run the Covaris DNA Shearing protocol for 200 Target BP Peak at 140 W peak incident power, 10% duty factor, 200 cycles per burst, 180 s treatment time, and 7°C temperature with water level set to 13.
Collect fragmented genomic DNA by pipetting through the microTUBE cap slit.
Continue library preparation according to the Ion Plus Library Preparation for the AB Library Builder™ System User Guide.
Elute DNA libraries in water.
Transfer all supernatant carefully to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Optional: Store barcoded DNA libraries at 4°C overnight or -20°C for up to one week.
Use 1 μL of eluate from step B.1.d or B.2.h to check bar-coded DNA library integrity with an Agilent High Sensitivity DNA nanochip.
Add 1.5X volume (45 μL) of Agencourt® AMPure XP beads to the bar-coded DNA library eluate.
Follow bind and wash steps in the Agencourt® AMPure protocol, except use 80% ethanol for the washes.
Elute in 32 μL of TE-1, pH8.0. Save 1 μL for analysis using Bioanalyzer 2100.
Transfer 30 μL of eluted product to a fresh 1.7 mL low-bind tube, ensuring no beads are carried over.
Combine 30 μL of the eluate from step C.2.d with 10 μL of the Pippin Prep loading dye with Marker L.
Mix well with micropipette and briefly spin to collect in bottom of tube.
Load 40 μL onto one lane of a 2% agarose gel for size selection.
Set the target to 315 bp, start at 290 bp, and end at 340 bp.
Collect the eluted sample (~40 μL) containing the size-selected DNA library fragments after run completion.
Add 1.5X volume (60 μL) of Agencourt® AMPure XP beads to the bar-coded DNA library eluate.
Follow the bind and wash steps in the Agencourt® AMPure protocol, using 80% ethanol for the washes.
Elute in 25 μL of TE-1, pH8.0, ensuring no beads are carried over.
Transfer all eluted product into a fresh 1.7 mL low-bind tube.
Size-select DNA library: 25 μL.
Add Platinum PCR High Fidelity mix: 100 μL.
Add Library Amplification Primer mix: 5 μL.
Combine all components for total volume of 130 μL.
Split the 130 μL into two PCR tubes, 65 μL per tube.
Place tubes in Thermocycler and run at 95 °C for 5 min.
Cycle through 95 °C for 15 sec, 58 °C for 15 sec, 70 °C for 60 sec (8–12 cycles).
Hold at 70 °C for 2 min.
Cool samples to 4 °C; proceed immediately to clean up step.
Clean up PCR reaction with AMPure XP beads: Add 1.8X volume of beads (234 μL) to the reaction and follow cleanup protocol.
Elute DNA in 52 μL TE-1 pH 8.0 buffer and carefully transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Measure concentration of DNA with Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit using manufacturer’s recommended instructions.
Determine concentration of each DNA library before proceeding to Capture Hybridization.
Prepare transposon Lockdown® Probes to 1.5 pmol/μL in IDTE pH 8.0.
Resuspend dry capture probes and blocking oligos in 10mM Tris-HCl, 0.1mM EDTA, pH 8.0 (TE-1) to a final pool concentration of 0.75 pmol/μL.
Mix thoroughly.
Briefly spin down the tube to collect contents at the bottom.
Suspend xGen Universal Blocking Oligos IT-P1 and IT-A in TE-1 pH 8.0 to a final concentration of 1 μL/library (1X final concentration).
Combine universal blocking oligos, mouse Cot-1 DNA, and the genomic DNA library.
Lyophilize the combined mixture.
Dry the contents of the tube using a vacuum concentrator set at 65°C or lower.
Add 8.5 μL SeqCap 2X Hybridization Buffer, 3.4 μL SeqCap Hybridization Component A, and 1.1 μL Nuclease-Free Water to the tube from Step F.3.b.
Pipette up and down to mix, and transfer to a low-bind 0.2 mL PCR tube.
Incubate in a thermal cycler at 95°C for 10 min.
Remove samples from thermal cycler and immediately add 4 μL of the pool of 2 lockdown probes and 5 blocking oligos.
Vortex and briefly spin down.
Incubate samples in a thermal cycler at 65°C (with the heated lid at 75°C) for 4 hr.
For each capture, dilute concentrated buffer to create 1X working solutions as follows:
Prepare 2.5X Bead Wash Buffer by adding 200 μL of concentrated buffer plus 300 μL of Nuclease-free water.
Prepare 1X Wash Buffer I by adding 30 μL of concentrated buffer plus 270 μL of Nuclease-free water.
Prepare 1X Wash Buffer II by adding 20 μL of concentrated buffer plus 180 μL of Nuclease-free water.
Prepare 1X Wash Buffer III by adding 20 μL of concentrated buffer plus 180 μL of Nuclease-free water.
Prepare 1X Stringent Wash Buffer by adding 40 μL of concentrated buffer plus 360 μL of Nuclease-free water.
Preheat buffers in a 65°C water bath for at least 2 hours before use.
Equilibrate Dynabeads® M-270 Streptavidin beads at room temperature for approximately 30 min before use.
Mix the beads thoroughly by vortexing for 15 sec.
Aliquot 100 μL of beads per capture into a single 1.7 mL low-bind tube.
Place the tube in a magnetic separation rack, allowing beads to fully separate from the supernatant.
Remove and discard the clear supernatant, ensuring that the beads remain in the tube.
Add 200 μL of 1X Bead Wash Buffer per capture and vortex for 10 sec.
Place the tube in the magnetic rack, allowing beads to fully separate from the supernatant.
Carefully remove and discard the clear supernatant.
Repeat Step F.6.g.i through g.iii.
Add 100 μL of 1X Bead Wash Buffer per capture and vortex.
Transfer 100 μL of the resuspended beads into a new 0.2 mL low-bind tube for each capture reaction.
Place the tube in a magnetic rack, allowing beads to fully separate from the supernatant.
Carefully remove and discard the clear supernatant.
Transfer the hybridization samples to the tube containing prepared beads.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Bind the DNA to the beads by placing the tube into a thermal cycler set to 65°C with the heated lid at 75°C for 45 min.
Every 15 min during the 65 °C incubation, carefully open the PCR tube lid and pipet up and down 8 times to ensure that the beads remain in suspension.
Work quickly at 65°C to ensure temperature remains close.
Add 100 μL preheated 1X Wash Buffer I to the tube from Step F.7.d.
Vortex the mixture for 10 seconds.
Transfer the mixture to a new low-bind 1.5 mL tube.
Briefly vortex the transferred mixture.
Place the tube in the magnetic rack, allowing beads to separate fully.
Pipet and discard the supernatant containing unbound DNA.
Add 200 μL of preheated 1X Stringent Wash Buffer to the tube.
Slowly pipet up and down 10 times without creating bubbles.
Incubate in a water bath at 65°C for 5 minutes.
Place the tube in the magnetic rack, allowing beads to separate fully.
Pipet and discard the supernatant containing unbound DNA.
Repeat wash with Stringent Wash Buffer as previously described.
Add 200 μL of room temperature 1X Wash Buffer I to the tube.
Vortex for 2 minutes.
Place the tube in the magnetic rack, allowing beads to separate fully.
Pipet and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μL of room temperature 1X Wash Buffer II to the tube.
Vortex for 1 minute.
Place the tube in the magnetic rack, allowing beads to separate fully.
Pipet and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μL of room temperature 1X Wash Buffer III to the tube.
Vortex for 30 seconds.
Place the tube in the magnetic rack to separate beads from supernatant.
Pipette and discard the supernatant.
Remove the tube from the magnetic rack.
Add 23 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to the beads.
Pipette up and down 10 times to resuspend any adhered beads.
Prepare the PCR mix in 0.2 mL low-bind PCR tubes containing:
Mix 25 μL of 2x KAPA HiFi Hot Start Ready Mix DNA Polymerase, 2 μL of Library Amplification Primer Mix, and 23 μL of captured DNA beads from resuspension step.
Briefly vortex and spin the PCR mix to keep beads in solution.
Place the PCR tube in the thermal cycler with heated lid at 105°C.
Run thermal cycling program: 98 °C for 45 sec, followed by cycles of 98 °C for 15 sec, 65 °C for 30 sec, and 72 °C for 30 sec (for 11–14 cycles), then a final extension at 72 °C for 1 min.
Hold the PCR tube at 4°C.
Add 75 μL of Agencourt® AMPure XP beads to the PCR-enriched capture.
Follow the bind and wash steps in the Agencourt® AMPure protocol, using 80% ethanol for the washes.
Elute in 35 μL of TE-1 pH 8.0.
Transfer 35 μL of eluted product to a fresh 1.7 mL low-bind tube, ensuring no beads are carried over.
Measure the average fragment length of the captured library on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer using a high sensitivity DNA nanochip with 1 μL of eluate from step H.4.
Quantify libraries using ViiA™ 7 Real-Time PCR System and the Ion library TaqMan Quantitation Kit with 2 μL of eluate from step H.4.
Determine the concentration of the ~30 μL of eluate from step H.4 for sequencing.
Dilute sequencing libraries for Ion Torrent sequencing according to experimental design for a single SB Capture Hybridization library per PI™ chip.
Prepare a diluted stock of eluted library from step H.4 to 50 pmol for multi-plex sequencing of 2–16 individual SB Capture Hybridization libraries per PI™ chip.
Prepare a diluted stock consisting of a pool of 2–16 eluted libraries from step H.4 to 50 pmol for multi-plex sequencing.
Set up Ion Chef for Ion PI™ Hi-Q™ Chef Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions using sequencing library/pooled-libraries mixture from step J.1.
Run Ion Chef chip loading overnight.
Prepare Ion Torrent Proton for sequencing and load PI™ chip using manufacturer’s instructions the next morning.
Complete a 500-flow sequencing run, which takes approximately 4 hours.
After sequencing is complete, use Torrent Suite™ Software to align reads to a Reference Genome and generate a chip run report.
Run analysis overnight until chip run report is generated.
Download and archive Ion Torrent Suite generated sequencing data files.
Prepare computer workstation for data analysis by downloading required installer and python scripts from https://github.com/jynewberg/sbcapseq.
Unzip the downloaded master archive if necessary.
Navigate to the directory containing the install.sh file using Terminal.app or a similar terminal emulator.
Execute the installer script by running bash install.sh.
Add sbcapseq toolbox scripts to system paths.
Convert Ion Torrent Suite sequencing data to FASTQ format if not already available.
Use samtools and the sam2fastq.py script to convert SAM format to FASTQ format:
samtools view -S [reads.sam] | sam2fastq.py - > [reads.fastq]
Use samtools and the sam2fastq.py script to convert BAM format to FASTQ format:
samtools view [reads.bam] | sam2fastq.py - > [reads.fastq]
Map the FASTQ reads to mouse TA sites using the fastq2tas.py script:
fastq2tas.py $HOME/nnlab/sbcapseq/srv [reads.fastq]
Convert the TA sites to BED format and mask potential hotspots:
tas2bed.py -f [insertions.txt] | maskbed.py $HOME/nnlab/sbcapseq/srv/protonMaskSites.bed - > [insertions.bed]
